- **`Verse(n)`** — validates the range (0–99, returns an error otherwise) and handles the three cases: the general case (uses a `bottles()` helper for the plural/singular/"no more" wording of the next count), verse 1 ("Take it down…"), and verse 0 ("Go to the store…"). - **`Song()`** — simply `Verses(99, 0)`, so the whole song stays consistent with the verse logic.

The bonus suggestion (removing duplication) is handled via the `bottles()` helper for the count/wording, keeping the special cases for 0 and 1 explicit for readability.
